system.description:
Standard Power Progression — 2 Basic, 2 Intermediate, 2 Advanced. You must take the levels of a Discipline in order (all Basic before Intermediate, etc.). Powers from other sourcebooks are grouped under "Expanded Options" in the compendium.

  • Basic (2): Consecrate the Grove, Crimson Woad
  • Intermediate (2): Inscribe the Curse, Moon and Sun
  • Advanced (2): Drink Dry the Earth, Inscribe the Forgotten Names

Base rating-tracker for the Ogham Discipline. Set the Rating field to your current level in this Discipline, and drag the individual Basic/Intermediate/Advanced/Elder powers you've learned from the Disciplines & Powers compendium into the Powers list below it.
